# Futures: Flat Files API Reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/sync-docs.mjs on 2026-10-15 from https://massive.com/docs/llms.txt. Do not edit by hand. -->

16 Flat Files endpoints. Start with [README.md](README.md) for this class's rules and gotchas.

Legend: `\*` = required parameter; `(.gt .gte …)` = comparison variants of that parameter
(e.g. `ticker.any_of=AAPL,MSFT`, `date.gte=2025-01-01`). **Plan** = cheapest individual plan that
includes the endpoint (`+`), then data recency and history depth per plan. Plan gates change: if a
call 403s on a listed plan, re-fetch the endpoint's doc page. Auth, envelope, and pagination rules:
[../foundations/README.md](../foundations/README.md).

## Minute Aggregates

### Minute Aggregates - CBOT

`S3 /futures/minute-aggregates/cbot` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/futures/minute-aggregates/cbot.md)

Candlestick data for CBOT futures with minute-by-minute open, high, low, close, and volume aggregated from all trades.

- **Columns:** `close dollar_volume exchange high low open session_end_date ticker transactions volume window_start`
- **Plan:** Starter+ · recency Starter–Advanced EOD · history Starter 2y · Developer 5y · Advanced all

## Quotes

### Quotes Aggregates - CBOT

`S3 /futures/quotes/cbot` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/futures/quotes/cbot.md)

Top-of-book quotes with nanosecond timestamps for CBOT futures, delivered as a daily downloadable S3 file.

- **Columns:** `ask_timestamp ask_price ask_size bid_timestamp bid_price bid_size exchange sequence_number report_sequence session_end_date ticker timestamp`
- **Plan:** Developer+ · recency Developer–Advanced EOD · history Developer 5y · Advanced all

## Session Aggregates

### Session Aggregates - CBOT

`S3 /futures/session-aggregates/cbot` · [docs](https://massive.com/docs/flat-files/futures/session-aggregates/cbot.md)
